ruleDefinitions.name: Metasploit Or Impacket Service Installation Via SMB PsExec
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of Metasploit SMB PsExec (exploit/windows/smb/psexec) and Impacket psexec.py by triggering on specific service installation Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceFileName, ServiceName, ServiceStartType, ServiceType

sequences.query: (event_id = 4697 AND ServiceFileName = RGX("^%systemroot%\[a-zA-Z]{8}.exe$") AND ServiceName = RGX("(^[a-zA-Z]{4}$)|(^[a-zA-Z]{8}$)|(^[a-zA-Z]{16}$)") AND ServiceStartType = 3 AND ServiceType = "0x10") AND  NOT (ServiceName = "PSEXESVC")
